params.command: $p='C:\Users\Xxkan\.config\opencode'; if(Test-Path $p){Get-ChildItem $p -Force | Select-Object Name,Length,LastWriteTimeUtc | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3; Get-ChildItem $p -File -Force | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('---FILE '+$_.Name+'---'); Get-Content $_.FullName | Where-Object {$_ -notmatch '(?i)(api.?key|token|secret|password|credential|authorization)'} | Select-String -Pattern '(?i)(provider|model|ollama|baseurl|localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)' | Select-Object -First 120 }}else{'CONFIG_DIR_MISSING'}
